name: kl-website
title: Investigative Journalism Reader
description: A mobile-first reader for independent investigative journalism — long-form reporting with offline saving, section browsing, search, and an encrypted way for sources to send tips.
audience: Readers who follow independent investigative reporting, and sources who need a private, encrypted way to pass on information.
useCases: A reader opens the app to today’s investigations and saves a long piece to read offline on the commute
Someone browses by beat to catch up on a running story, then searches for an earlier related report
A source with sensitive information uses the secure-tip flow to reach the newsroom without leaving a trail
A returning reader installs the app to the home screen and reads in a clean, distraction-free reader view

dataPrivacy.storage: Saved articles and preferences are kept on-device. Content is served over the network; no account is needed to read.
dataPrivacy.tips: The secure-tip flow is designed so sources can reach the newsroom privately.
